prompt: Build the unitary produced by: (1) the standard circuit (Hadamard on all 4 qubits, then the phase exp(-i*gamma*H) where H = 0.2*Z0 - 0.4*Z1 + 0.3*Z2 + 0.1*Z3 + 0.5*Z0*Z1 + 0.3*Z2*Z3, gamma = 0.45), followed by (2) an additional RZ(pi/4) gate applied to qubit 0. This is a general-purpose circuit block, not a fixed starting state. No measurement.
